Use synthetic examples only. Do not include private deployment data or credentials.
Vulnerabilities follow the [security policy](https://github.com/callcthulu/cloudflare-cost-guard/security/policy).

## Problem

What documented use case is difficult or missing? Check current capabilities and
existing issues first.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful change and alternatives considered. Include a synthetic
example if useful. Do not assume complete billing coverage or a spending guarantee.

## Safety and validation

Which permissions, provider contracts, data-quality or observe/enforcement boundaries
would change? How could the behavior and its failure paths be verified offline?
